description:
- Implemented real SQL execution and capture for TPC-DS Power, Throughput, and Maintenance tests when running in CLI dry-run mode via platform adapter wrappers.
- "Added context-aware labeling for captured SQL:"
- DryRunExecutor now prefers labeled outputs from test classes for accurate preview titles and grouping.
- Tests added to validate labeled outputs for each mode.
- "Impact: Dry-run preview now reflects the precise execution sequence and SQL users can expect, improving debuggability and trust in the CLI."
